title: Tests: a failed carried batch gate and a foreground launcher gate record no members, read no held claims and owe no binds
outcome: Flow tests in src/tests/engram_batch_gate_flow.rs pin two rules that are stated but untested. (1) A carried batch gate whose run failed leaves no pending batch and no owed bind; the credit path's Succeeded filter in engram_carried_checks.rs is what enforces this. (2) A foreground (Ordinary) launcher full gate, or a dropped one, records no bind_targets and makes no held-claims request, because engram_launch_needs_held_read is limited to the Carry disposition. Both rules are stated in the engram_batch_binds.rs header and in docs/features/batch-full-gates.md ("Only a carried gate records members"; "A failed or refused gate binds nothing").
acceptance: Tests: a failed carried batch gate and a foreground launcher gate record no members, read no held claims and owe no binds is done
